after.text: Port the landed git-source-only overlay form rule into the Go reader so a path overlay is declarable from all three production surfaces, and make the candidate lane green against curator-spec main. Stage (c) was written against authority 550579d and passes there; the reconciliation landed as 87a0d00 after that authority was frozen, so this is consumption work rather than a defect in stage (c).

Stage (c) review cycle 5 measured it: candidate dispatch 34052590291 against curator-spec 87a0d00 fails on all three runners, only in internal/config, on TestManagerConfigV2SchemaCases and TestManagerConfigV2Vectors, exactly 30 subcases on ubuntu. Every one is a case bd39adb or 2f2dfa4 added after 550579d: valid-overlay-path-* now rejected because this tree still requires a form on every overlay, invalid-overlay-*-with-form now accepted for the same reason, plus valid.json and schema2-every-knob. Every other package serves and passes. Against 550579d the same families run and pass, and against SPEC_PIN the three registered root-artifact rows defer as designed. The work: parse the source-kind spelling discriminator the schema now encodes (a two-or-more-character scheme in the core 6.1 set, an SCP form with a 6.1 host and no backslash after the colon, a Windows drive letter carved out ahead of it), require the form only for a git source, and reach the path overlay from the config reader, resolveOverlay and profile compose add. Stage (c) carries an explicit bound naming the predecessor spec task; retire it here.

A path overlay declared in machine configuration is reachable from all three production surfaces and joins the closure with its weight, driven through run(). The candidate lane against curator-spec main with CI_REQUIRE_FULL_ROOT=1 is green on all three runners. The stale bound and its ledger wording are retired. Every new refusal is proven by a narrowing mutant that kills a named test.
